pair_hint: Not paired yet. In the Persona app, go to Settings › Connectors › Lark bot, tap Pair, and send me the 6-digit code it shows.
pair_wrong: That code is wrong. You have {n} more tries.
pair_expired: That code has expired. Open the app and generate a new one.
owner_only: This bot only works for its owner.
owner_only_action: Only the bot's owner can do this
paired_body: From now on, what you say here goes to Persona. Send /help to see what you can do.
card_refused: (This message couldn't be shown as a card. See it in the app.)
topics_on: Done: from now on, what you write inside a topic of this group chat goes to Persona. Only your own messages count. Send /topics off to turn it off.
topics_off: Done: this group chat is off. Persona reads nothing from it any more.
topics_already: This group chat is already on. Send /topics off to turn it off.
topics_full: Too many group chats are on already. Turn one off first.
topics_home: Done: this group chat is the home topic group now. A request that comes from another group opens its topic here.
topics_on_home: Done: this group chat is on, and it is the home topic group. A request that comes from another group opens its topic here. Only your own messages count.
topics_home_already: This group chat is already the home topic group.
chat_not_enabled: This chat isn't turned on for the bot. Send /topics in it first.
chat_unknown: Couldn't tell which chat this card is in. Try again in a moment.
